title: Improper Neutralization of Script-Related HTML Tags in a Web Page (Basic XSS) vulnerability in eLightUp Slim SEO…
description: A Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in eLightUp Slim SEO up to version 4.11.5 due to improper neutralization of script-related HTML tags. This flaw allows code injection via crafted input that is not properly sanitized.
